items.text: A failed batch commits neither tasks nor cursor. A successful batch persists both. Reopen the on-disk store to verify. One host's failure leaves a second host able to commit, and background flush persists its pending batch.

Persist LogReset reconciliation state. Kill and relaunch during reconciliation, resume at the last committed cursor, replay duplicate events and check message counts, revisions, unread state and approvals.

From a fresh install create distinct sessions on two hosts with the same task ID, approvals, queues and attachments. Relaunch the same install offline, verify host-specific rows, history and thumbnails against the persisted records and cursors, then reconnect and check the resulting state.

The external domain snapshot probe compiles on both platforms and the CachedTask.stateRaw probe now fails for the expected reason. SwiftData and raw persistence types stay inside DSHPlatform; its signatures and implementation do not import Core or Features.
